courseName: Interprofessional Capstone in Nutrition and Exercise Physiology

response.courseDescription: 495 [M] Interprofessional Capstone in Nutrition and Exercise Physiology Culminating experience for senior undergraduates in NEP and health science fields; interprofessional approach to address the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of a variety of health conditions.
response.coursePrerequisites: Admitted to the major in Nutrition and Exercise Physiology, Nursing, or Speech and Hearing Sciences at WSU Spokane; senior standing.
